Name: Items to start with
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
[b]Do you get frustrated with how slow the beginning of the game can be?  Do you wish for a head start? Look no more. This mod gives you the choice to receive copper tools, accessories (hat, shoes, rings), craftables and other useful items.  
[/b]
Default is to receive all items. Launch Stardew Valley. T[b]o enable the settings you want, click the cog wheel on the bottom left of the Stardew Valley title screen. 
[/b]You now have the option of Copper or Gold tools.  Unless you want both select an option.

Each item is delivered by mail with an unique letter. 

Can be used with an existing game, you will receive all items in the first spring after installing.

[u]*Make sure you have an empty space before checking the mail.*[/u]  

Items you will get and the day you should get them:
1 Small Glow Ring // day 5
2 Small Magnet Ring // day 7
[b]3 Copper or Gold Hoe // day 3
4 Copper or Gold Axe // day 4
5 Copper or Gold Pickaxe // day 7
6 Copper or Gold Water can // day 8[/b]
7 Rubber Boots // day 6
8 Work Boots // day 9
9 Spotted Headscraf //day 10
10 Fishing Hat // day 6
11 Chest // day 3
12 Recyling Machine // day 2
13 Scare Crow // day 10
14 Iron Lamp Post // day 12
15 Calendar // day 5
16 Dresser // day 11 
17 Silver Sable // day 14
18 Fiberglass Rod// day 13
19 Seeds // day 8
20 Money // day 2

[u][i]With V3.5.0 the NPC will send you a letter on their birthday. Be sure to share with them. [/i][/u]

Translations are welcome.
